slots.text: About 85 metres deep, with churches, dining halls and stables, once home to around 30,000. Only 10% can be visited.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Kaymaklı Underground City
slots.text: Eight floors carved underground, with houses linked by hidden passages that protected against enemies.
slots.food: Dried clotted cream with honey, or sherbet, in the town.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Ürgüp
slots.text: The most touristic and bustling town in Cappadocia, with elegant restaurants and nightlife. See the Three Beauties fairy chimneys.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Ihlara Valley
slots.text: One of Turkey's largest canyons, with a walk past cave churches with wall paintings. A 14-kilometre route reaches Belisırma.
slots.food: Tea in the pergolas over the Melendiz Stream.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Avanos pottery
slots.text: The centre of pottery since the Hittite period. Make your own with an instructor, and visit the 2nd-century Yamanlı Church.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Zelve
slots.text: The densest site of fairy chimneys, in three valleys, which glow crimson in the setting sun.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: The Charminar
slots.text: Built in 1591, with four soaring minarets and a bazaar at its base. Walk the precinct early to dodge the crowds.
slots.food: Cafe Nimrah, next to the monument, for Irani chai and an Osmania biscuit.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Chowmahalla Palace and Laad Bazaar
slots.text: Where the Nizams were crowned, then Laad Bazaar for lacquered bangles and bridal finery.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Hyderabadi biryani
slots.text: Hyderabadi biryani made the top 10 of TasteAtlas's best rice dishes in 2025. Try the kacchi, pakki or sealed dum versions.
slots.food: Paradise, Shah Ghouse and Bawarchi, with mirchi salan or raita.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Salar Jung Museum
slots.text: 46,000 art pieces from Mughal miniatures to European sculpture, and the Veiled Rebecca. Weekday mornings avoid school trips.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Paigah Tombs
slots.text: A late 18th-century necropolis blending eight architectural styles, with over 35 jaali patterns. Closed Fridays.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Falaknuma Palace
slots.venue: Taj Falaknuma Palace: high tea and heritage walk
slots.text: Italian marble staircases and chandeliers; the Adaa restaurant's 101-foot table is said to be the world's longest.
slots.food: Nizami cuisine, including the Jauzi halwa.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Qutb Shahi Tombs
slots.text: The Seven Tombs sit in a 106-acre heritage park with over 70 monuments, ideal at sunrise or golden hour.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Golconda Fort
slots.text: Pair the tombs with the nearby fort for a full-day heritage binge.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Bar Kin Rü
slots.text: A craft bar serving Mughal-inspired dishes, with theatrical cocktails on the fifth floor, in India's Top 30 Bars list for 2024.
slots.food: The Jackfruit Haleem.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Galle Fort and the lighthouse
slots.text: A UNESCO site over the Indian Ocean, with ramparts resembling those on Portugal's coast and a lighthouse that has guided sailors ashore.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Maritime and National museums
slots.text: The Maritime Archaeology Museum in the Fort, then the Galle National Museum, in a building from 1656.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Old Dutch Hospital
slots.text: The former Dutch hospital is now a shopping complex of restaurants, boutiques and gem shops.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Dutch Reformed Church
slots.text: An elegant church from 1754 in the Fort, with its records of marriages and baptisms. Admire the Dutch houses and the Dutch gate.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Galapatha Temple
slots.text: Not far from the main city, it houses the tooth relic of Arhat Maha Kassapa.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Galleries and antique shops
slots.venue: The Boutique, Gem & Gallery Lanes of the Fort
slots.text: The Fort's houses have been turned into restaurants, art galleries, antique shops and fashionable boutiques.
slots.food: End at a pleasant street-side café.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Midigama
slots.text: A golden beach near Galle with palm trees, turquoise water and the south coast's unique stilt fishermen.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Talalla
slots.text: A tranquil beach with soft golden sand, for swimming or surfing, away from the bustle.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Hiriketiya Bay
slots.text: A horseshoe-shaped cove in Dickwella with a tranquil shore, turquoise water and swaying coconut palms.

days.title: Dhoni cruising and an underwater dinner

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Dhoni boat cruise
slots.text: A traditional dhoni takes you to a new destination each day, with snorkelling spots, reefs, uninhabited islands and local villages.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Parasailing
slots.text: Led by a speedboat, a parachute lifts you high over the islands and reefs. Available at most major resorts.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: SEA at Anantara Kihavah
slots.text: An underwater restaurant where sharks, turtles and fish pass by as you eat Maldivian cuisine.
slots.food: The fresh Maldivian lobster.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: South Ari Atoll
slots.text: Swim with huge, harmless whale sharks in the South Ari Atoll, near Sun Island and Rangali Island.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Underwater spa at Huvafen Fushi
slots.text: The world's first underwater spa retreat, for adults only, with massages using the island's coconut oil.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Subsix at Niyama
slots.text: The world's first underwater nightclub. The glow party runs on Wednesdays and Saturdays from 9pm.

days.title: Island culture in the Baa Atoll

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Thulhaadhoo
slots.text: A small Baa Atoll island of lacquerware artisans, reached from Malé by speedboat, ferry or hydroplane.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Maalhos
slots.text: A traditional fishing village of about 600 people, one of the oldest islands in the Baa Atoll, for relaxing and snorkelling.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Finolhu
slots.text: An island resort with a beach club, where the 1 Oak Beach Club comes alive at sunset with cocktails and performers.
slots.food: Tuesday's Seafood Extravaganza at the Fish and Crab Shack.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Leh Palace
slots.text: Spend your first days in Leh, resting while you acclimatise. The 17th-century palace shows a Tibetan influence in its architecture.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Shanti Stupa
slots.text: One of Leh's most gorgeous sights, with the outskirts holding Magnetic Hill, Sangam and Gurudwara Pathar Sahib.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: Leh Market
slots.venue: Leh café evenings: Gesmo & the Main Bazaar
slots.text: Wander the market on foot after the day, with cafés and bars. Lehchen is one of the city's few bars.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Khardung La
slots.venue: Khardung La (Among The World's Highest Passes)
slots.text: The road to Nubra climbs over one of the highest motorable passes, so start early and allow for traffic at the photo stops.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Diskit Monastery
slots.text: In Nubra, the cold desert turns green for a short while. One night is enough for the double-humped Bactrian camels and Diskit Monastery.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: A Nubra camp
slots.text: Many travellers simply arrive and choose a stay in person, while higher-end luxury camps are worth booking ahead.

slots.label: Morning
slots.title: Chang La
slots.text: Cross Chang La on the way to Pangong, allowing for the tiring altitude and for stops for tea and photos.

slots.label: Afternoon
slots.title: Pangong Tso
slots.text: The brackish lake shifts through blue, green and grey depending on the sunlight, and freezes over in winter. Part of it lies in China.

slots.label: Evening
slots.title: A night by the lake
slots.text: Accommodation here is limited, dry and remote. One night is enough to experience the lake.
